ticket.empty.desc: Create your first ticket to get started.
ticket.empty.filtered: No tickets match your current filters.
ticket.col.title: Title
ticket.reassign.title: Reassign ticket
ticket.reassign.description: Pick the agent who should take over this ticket. The reason will be permanently audited.
ticket.reassign.assignee_hint: Pick an agent who has logged in at least once.
ticket.reassign.no_agents: No agents have logged in yet.
ticket.reassign.reason_hint: Required — audited and visible on the timeline.
ticket.reassign.reason_placeholder: Why are you reassigning this ticket?
attachment.hint: Optional — files up to 10 MB each.
attachment.title: Attachments
ticket.urgency.hint: How urgent does this feel from your side?
ticket.override.title: Override ticket status
ticket.override.description: Manager intervention. Bypasses normal transition rules — the reason is permanently audited.
ticket.override.reason_hint: Required — explain why this exceptional intervention is needed.
ticket.override.reason_placeholder: e.g., Reopening to investigate a regression report from finance team.
sla.title: SLA
sla.clock.paused: Clock paused while waiting for customer
ticket.resolve.title: Resolve ticket
ticket.resolve.description: Provide a short summary of how this issue was resolved. This will be visible on the timeline and recorded in the audit log.
ticket.resolve.note_hint: Required — describe the fix or workaround applied.
ticket.resolve.note_placeholder: e.g., Replaced the faulty network switch in rack B-12; service restored after restart.
ticket.confirm_close.title: Confirm closure
ticket.confirm_close.description: By confirming, this ticket will be marked as closed.
ticket.confirm_close.body: If the issue is resolved to your satisfaction, confirm to close. Otherwise reopen and add a comment with more detail.
ticket.force_close.title: Force close ticket
ticket.force_close.description: Manager override — closure will skip customer confirmation and be recorded in the audit log.
ticket.force_close.reason_hint: Required — this reason is permanently audited.
ticket.force_close.reason_placeholder: Explain why this ticket is being closed without customer confirmation.
ticket.priority.title: Change priority
ticket.priority.description: Adjust impact and urgency — priority is recalculated automatically from the matrix.
ticket.priority.reason_hint: Required — every priority change is audited.
ticket.priority.reason_placeholder: Why are you changing this ticket's priority?
approval.approve.title: Approve service request
approval.approve.description: Approving this request allows the agent to start working and resolve the ticket.
approval.approve.body: Once approved, the assigned agent will be able to resolve this ticket. This action is recorded in the audit log.
approval.reject.title: Reject service request
approval.reject.description: Rejecting this request blocks resolution. The reason is permanently audited.
approval.reject.reason_hint: Required — explain why this request is being rejected.
approval.reject.reason_placeholder: e.g., Request does not comply with procurement policy.
